verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an API Explorer that lets users make live API calls in a browser with a guided interface to test endpoints without writing code, which matches the interactive/runnable-example story. However, no OpenAPI spec was discoverable via probe (all candidate paths 404), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the explorer's depth or coverage. Missing for 10: discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent/hands-on validation of the API Explorer's runnable examples across endpoints.
